items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had the good fortune of playing with Charlie Parker, but never on the road.

ctx.x: How special was it to be around Charlie Parker and play with him? Did you learn anything from him? What can you tell us about whatever of person he was from your perspective?

I had the good fortune of playing with Charlie Parker, but never on the road. Except for Jazz at the Philharmonic, I never played within a nightclub setting. But, I was always impressed by his calm approached everything in place. His music was exciting, but he himself was perfectly calm.
